scope: AIOC-only preimplementation contract closure; no Multiversal-app PCV runtime implementation, migration execution, secret migration, hosted activation or package mutation

durable_truth_model.invariant: Canonical owner-domain records and ordered Session history are one semantic truth. Deployment profile selects the persistence adapter only; it never creates a second owner or divergent canonical history.
durable_truth_model.canonical_semantic_model: Provider-neutral logical owner schema and typed owner contracts represented by the Phase-9/A5 schema lineage plus additive reviewed migrations.
durable_truth_model.installed_physical_adapter: One installed SQLite database may materialize multiple canonical owner tables transactionally while preserving owner-domain write boundaries.
durable_truth_model.local_document_store_disposition: local_documents remains valid for shell/preferences, nonauthoritative drafts/caches, compatibility projections and bounded migration staging. PCV Campaign membership, invitation authority, authenticated device/session authority, Session/Event/checkpoint/operation receipt state may not exist only as opaque JSON local_documents and may not be written in parallel to canonical owner rows as a second truth.
durable_truth_model.managed_profile_mapping: SMB-01 PostgreSQL PersistencePort materializes the same logical owner records/invariants. Provider exit moves provider-neutral logical records and history, not vendor-specific authority.
durable_truth_model.no_dual_write_rule: A compatibility JSON projection may be updated only from a successfully committed canonical transaction or rebuilt afterward. Projection failure cannot roll back or redefine canonical state.

canonical_to_installed.installed: SQLite canonical tables via local PersistencePort adapter
canonical_to_installed.json_projection: ProductProfile identifiers are migration/UX projection only
PCV-02 memberSubjectIds becomes read-only derived compatibility projection

canonical_to_installed.installed: SQLite canonical tables; only digest/reference metadata persisted

canonical_to_installed.logical_owner: game_sessions + session_commands + session_events + session_projections + checkpoints + outbox_events
additive resume_credential metadata + delivery cursor/recovery metadata
canonical_to_installed.installed: SQLite canonical metadata rows plus SecretStorePort handles for bearer material

transaction_contract.local_realization_requirement: PCV runtime later implements the local PersistencePort over one SQLite connection and one database transaction. Multi-owner compositions use a single transaction boundary; LocalDocumentStore get/put/delete is not the authoritative transaction primitive.
sqlite_semantics: begin one write transaction before authoritative reads that participate in the mutation
apply expected-version/current-state checks inside that transaction
write owner rows, operation/idempotency receipt, audit event and durable outbox record in the same commit where required
commit once; any failed authorization, uniqueness, version, persistence, audit or outbox condition rolls back all authoritative changes
publish advisory realtime only after durable commit; outbox/event sequence is recovery source
required_atomic_groups: A3 invitation accept + A5 membership create/reactivate + invitation terminal acceptance + idempotency/audit/outbox
membership role/state transition + permissions/version evidence + audit/outbox
Session lifecycle/authority-epoch transition + credential revocation metadata + Event/checkpoint/outbox where applicable
serialized Session command acceptance + idempotency fingerprint/receipt + ordered Event append + checkpoint/recovery metadata when the governing operation advances them
transaction_contract.concurrency_rule: Optimistic versions remain public concurrency tokens, but cross-record correctness is decided inside the transaction. Stale expectedVersion/idempotency conflict fails with zero partial authoritative mutation.
transaction_contract.browser_development_rule: Browser localStorage fallback is development-only and cannot certify PCV authoritative atomicity, secure secrets or installed recovery.

logical_schema_delta.migration_rule: Use additive reviewed migration(s); do not rewrite 0001 or 0003 history. Exact migration number/name is assigned during authorized PCV runtime implementation after the then-current migration registry is revalidated.

canonical_fields.role: materializes PCV-I01B primaryRole using A5 vocabulary; owner remains campaigns.owner_subject_id

campaign_members.joined_at_disposition: Preserve as historical initial effective/join time; it does not substitute for current state/version.
campaign_members.uniqueness: campaign_id + subject_id remains one current membership identity; left/removed reactivation requires new governed invitation semantics from PCV-I01B rather than a silent role overwrite.

campaign_invitations.secret_rule: token_digest is a one-way verification digest over a cryptographically random bearer value with context/version separation; raw bearer value never enters SQLite ordinary rows, JSON documents, logs, diagnostics or telemetry.
campaign_invitations.secure_reference_rule: If implementation requires a retrievable local invitation secret for host display/rendezvous, SQLite stores only an opaque SecretStorePort handle plus lifecycle metadata; the secret itself lives in the secure store and is deleted/revoked at terminal lifecycle.

required_durable_families: device binding: deviceId, subjectId, credentialId, safe label, status, timestamps, revision, replacement/revocation lineage
credential verifier: credentialId, subjectId, identityId, deviceId, algorithm, public key, status, timestamps, revision

stable subject session: sessionId, subjectId, identityId, status, authentication assurance, credentialId, deviceId, last validated permission/entitlement versions, timestamps, revision and terminal reason
identity_device_and_stable_session.private_key_rule: Private signing key is local-secret material and remains non-exportable by default in platform secure key storage; canonical durable store contains verifier/public metadata only.

session_recovery_metadata.session_authority_epoch: Canonical durable per-Session monotonic authority generation. Transport state cannot mint or rewrite it.
session_recovery_metadata.resume_credential: Canonical metadata stores credential id, digest, subject/device/session scope, bound authority epoch, status, issued/expires/revoked timestamps and revision. Raw resume bearer is SecretStorePort material only.
session_recovery_metadata.delivery_ack_cursor: Durable recovery metadata keyed at least by subjectId+campaignId+sessionId+deviceId; acknowledges only delivered/processed projection state. Exact advancement/gap semantics remain PCV-I04.
session_recovery_metadata.replay_fingerprint: Durable recovery/checkpoint metadata binding the authoritative restored history/state; exact algorithm/lifecycle remains PCV-I04.
session_recovery_metadata.checkpoint_digest: Durable content digest/checksum over canonical checkpoint content, not a self-referential label; exact algorithm/lifecycle remains PCV-I04.
session_recovery_metadata.presence: Ephemeral/advisory connection-derived projection; may have bounded last-seen diagnostics but cannot become membership, identity or Session authority.
session_recovery_metadata.transport_connection_state: SDP, ICE candidates, connectionId, transient channel state and backpressure queues are ephemeral and excluded from canonical/backup authority.

state_classification.export: only through explicitly encrypted recovery path when policy permits; routine export excludes

state_classification.store: SecretStorePort only if retrievable use is required
state_classification.export: never routine export/backup; terminal lifecycle deletes/revokes
never routine export/backup; fresh rebind/reissue after device migration
only when needed for portable recovery; never treated as gameplay canon

secure_secret_store.selected_vault: Tauri official Stronghold plugin 2.3.2 line, pinned exactly at implementation time after lockfile verification
secure_secret_store.supported_target_reason: Current Tauri v2 official plugin documentation lists Stronghold as an encrypted secure database and supports Windows and Android.

platform_unlock_protection.windows: Protect a random per-installation vault unlock seed with Windows DPAPI CurrentUser semantics (CryptProtectData/CryptUnprotectData without machine-wide scope). Never use CRYPTPROTECT_LOCAL_MACHINE for a per-user Multiversal secret vault.
platform_unlock_protection.android: Protect/wrap the per-installation vault unlock seed with an Android Keystore key; key material remains non-exportable where supported and the vault/seed files are excluded from cloud backup and device-to-device transfer.
platform_unlock_protection.common: Stronghold password/unlock material must never be a hard-coded constant, checked-in value, ordinary SQLite/local_documents field, telemetry property or diagnostic attachment.

secure_secret_store.permissions: Tauri Stronghold dangerous commands/scopes remain capability-deny-by-default; enable only the minimum SecretStorePort operations required by the installed product.
secure_secret_store.handles: Ordinary durable records carry opaque secret handle/id, digest, lifecycle/status and version only. Handle values reveal no secret material.
secure_secret_store.memory_rule: Read bearer material as late as possible, zero/drop it as early as practical, and never serialize it into diagnostic objects.
secure_secret_store.failure_rule: If secure storage is unavailable, locked, corrupt or platform binding changed, authentication/invitation/resume operations requiring that secret fail closed and enter governed rebind/reissue/recovery; no plaintext fallback.

backup_export_delete_provider_exit.routine_backup: .mvarchive includes verified canonical SQLite snapshot/history and safe metadata but excludes live SecretStorePort vault contents, raw bearer tokens and non-exportable device private keys.
backup_export_delete_provider_exit.encrypted_recovery_archive: A separately explicit user-created encrypted recovery archive may carry the recovery material allowed by PCV-I01A. It is not the ordinary backup path and may not carry live invitation/resume bearer tokens merely for convenience.
backup_export_delete_provider_exit.android_backup: Secure vault/unlock-seed files must be excluded from Android cloud backup and device-to-device transfer rules. Restored ordinary data on a new/reimaged device requires fresh device credential binding and fresh Session/resume credentials.
backup_export_delete_provider_exit.windows_restore: DPAPI CurrentUser-protected vault seed is device/user-bound. If protection context is unavailable after restore/reimage, fail closed and use governed recovery/rebind rather than weakening scope.
backup_export_delete_provider_exit.export: Subject/data-right exports include user-owned canonical data and safe lineage/metadata within authorized scope; secret vault contents, raw credentials/tokens and unrelated context data are excluded.
backup_export_delete_provider_exit.delete: Subject/data-right deletion removes or tombstones canonical data per owner/lifecycle policy and deletes associated SecretStorePort entries/handles on the local device where present; audit obligations retain only permitted non-secret evidence.
backup_export_delete_provider_exit.provider_exit: Export provider-neutral logical records, Events/checkpoints, operation receipts, safe verifier metadata and schema/version provenance. Provider-specific secret handles are nonportable and must be reissued/rebound at destination.

legacy_migration_retirement.source_schema: PCV-03.session.1 and PCV-03.client.1 from historical pre-audit Multiversal-app PR #775; never completed/canonical runtime.
legacy_migration_retirement.discovery: Before any future PCV runtime opens legacy pcv03_session state writable, enumerate bounded namespace keys and classify host.*, active-host, continuity.*, device and unknown records under a migration journal.

host_records.disposition: retire/quarantine; never upgrade as trusted A5/P9 Session authority
safe_preservation: event/audit references only where visibility/data-right rules allow
host_records.authority: mark legacy Session retired and all legacy invitation/resume credentials revoked/unusable

continuity_records.disposition: invalidate; remove raw resumeToken and any transport-derived authority
continuity_records.safe_preservation: only non-secret campaign/session/subject/device identifiers needed for a migration receipt or user-facing recovery explanation
continuity_records.restart_rule: Require fresh current A3 authentication, current A5 membership authorization and new governed Session/reconnect establishment.

legacy_migration_retirement.active_host_pointer: Delete/ignore; it cannot select authoritative Session after repair.
legacy_migration_retirement.legacy_device_record: A bare PCV-03 deviceId is a migration hint only. Reuse only after explicit reconciliation to a current A3 device binding; otherwise enroll a new deviceId/credential through PCV-I01A.
legacy_migration_retirement.pcv01_profile: subjectId/identityId are migration inputs only until reconciled through IdentityServicePort + ProviderIndependentIdentityMapping and current proof-of-possession.
legacy_migration_retirement.pcv02_member_subject_ids: becomes derived read-only projection from Campaign owner + active A5 memberships. Legacy non-owner rows without matching role/lifecycle evidence remain migration-pending/quarantined; never guess player/gm/owner.
migration_receipt: retired Session ids or safe digests
legacy_migration_retirement.no_secret_receipt_rule: Migration receipts, diagnostics and telemetry contain no raw token, private key, vault unlock material or secret-derived reversible value.
legacy_migration_retirement.uncertain_commit_rule: Follow DB-003 migration journal behavior: idempotently resume only from a known cursor or restore a verified snapshot; uncertain commits enter manual recovery.

permitted: counts that do not leak hidden cardinality
telemetry_and_diagnostics.error_rule: Safe errors identify category and recovery action without echoing presented secret material or disclosing accepted recipient/subject.

external_sanity_checks.use: official encrypted secret/key store; Windows and Android support; capability permissions are deny-by-default

Android Keystore for long-term cryptographic key protection
sensitive local state can and should be separated/excluded from cloud and device-to-device backup rules
protect local vault-unlock seed to the current Windows user/computer context; avoid machine-wide scope
session identifiers, access tokens, encryption keys and primary secrets should not be logged directly

runtime_boundary.next_runtime_destination: PCV-03A/03B only after PCV-I03 through PCV-I06 predecessor closure
